liner.body_md:
## Setlist highlights

- **The Race Is On**: back after 360 archived shows (2170 days) [21]

## The recordings

- **gd1980-09-27.155901.akg.se5.wiseman.miller.clugston.flac2496** (recommended): audience recording; 33 songs; 211 min [1]
- **gd1980-09-27.144699.nak700.severson.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 34 songs; 216 min [3]
- **gd80-09-27.sbd.clugston.11590.sbeok.shnf**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 31 songs; 210 min; rated 2/5 by 2 [5]. Said about its sound: Jack-A-Roe through Ripple sounds good and mellow; the remainder of the matrix sounds hollow; Reviewer finds the matrix's sound quality poor [14][16]
- **gd80-09-27.nakcm700.jeffm.7998.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 31 songs; 209 min; rated 3/5 by 1 [6]. Said about its sound: Audience recording is weak early on but improves; heavy on bass, with some higher notes lacking [15]
- **gd1980-09-27.nak300.walker-scotton.miller.89006.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 32 songs; 209 min [8]
- **gd1980-09-27.sbd.cantor.gmb.96271.flac16**: soundboard; 9 songs; 48 min; rated 3.33/5 by 3 [12]. Said about its sound: In the streamed soundboard, Bird Song has an overlapping-audio defect that makes it hard to listen to; Soundboard has out-of-sync parts in Bird Song's first minute, then it clears up [17][18]

## Around the show

- The reviewer attended all of the weekend shows at this venue [13]
- Reviewer ranks the acoustic set on the 11th as the best of those Warfield shows [13]
- Cold Rain & Snow and CC Rider shared a show only 19 times, same set 14; here played back to back [19]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1980-09-27.155901.akg.se5.wiseman.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Scott Wiseman; transferred by Scott Clugston, Scott Wiseman; source: Scott Wiseman's Master Audience Cassettes; AKG SE-5E mics with CE-1 cardioid capsules > Sony TC-D5 (TDK SA-90) [1]. Also: Mark Severson's Nakamichi 700 tape patches crowd and song openings, an Althea gap, and CC Rider from 3:42 [1]
- **gd1980-09-27.144699.nak700.severson.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Mark Severson; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Mark Severson's Master Audience Cassettes; (3) x Nakamichi 700 mics (left/right cardioids, omni center - handheld shoulder high)> Custom mixer by Jamie Poris >… [3]. Also: A Nakamichi 300 source from Joani Walker and Paul Scotton supplies a 0:42 patch in Drums [3]
- **gd80-09-27.sbd.clugston.11590.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Scott Clugston; source: Soundboard and Audience composite [5]. Also: Acoustic set comes from the master soundboard reel, taken to PCM, then DAT, then CDR; Electric sets come from a master audience cassette [5]
- **gd80-09-27.nakcm700.jeffm.7998.sbeok.shnf**: source: Audience Recording: Nak CM700's [6]
- **gd1980-09-27.nak300.walker-scotton.miller.89006.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Joani Walker; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Nakamichi 300 -> Cassette Master (Sony D5M/Maxell UDXL-II90) [8]. Also: Nakamichi 700 cassette master went to cassette, DAT, then CD; tapes came from Joani Walker and Paul Scotton [8]
- **gd1980-09-27.sbd.cantor.gmb.96271.flac16**: taped by Betty Cantor; transferred by Bill Koucky; source: 7" two track reel w/DBX-1 @ 7 1/2 ips> PCM501ES @ 44.055 kHz PCM501ES analog out > DBX-1 decoder> analog in PCM501ES analog out > Dat @ 48 kHz [12]
